name: Moonwell cbETH OEV feed denomination mismatch
summary: Moonwell's ChainlinkOracle expects each configured feed to return a USD-denominated value. MIP-X43 instead assigned cbETH a CBETH/ETH wrapper that returned the roughly 1.12 exchange ratio, so getUnderlyingPrice valued one cbETH at about $1.12 rather than $2,206.68. This made healthy cbETH-backed accounts liquidatable for negligible debt repayment and made cbETH cheap to over-borrow.
notes: MIP-X43 changed the cbETH feed from composite oracle 0xb0ba0c5d7da4ec400c1c3e5ef2485134f89918c5 to CBETH/ETH wrapper 0x67996d1ff7a3711a91e2839d1059fcb950c0495d. Across the execution block getUnderlyingPrice(mcbETH) fell from 2,206.683650838065175827e18 to 1.122662744874806300e18.

Moonwell's live remediation ledger values each affected liquidation at its contemporaneous corrected collateral and debt prices, then defines borrower net loss as collateral seized minus debt repaid. Its 859 rows total $5,516,843.594852737 seized minus $2,811,445.0752305076 repaid = $2,705,398.519622221. One $45.997226547535 rETH/cbXRP liquidation in transaction 0xa8c0a1783c947d4fa9b95cf14771ad25c712dad860ae274700f02ea83443653f predates the bad configuration by 9 hours 43 minutes and is excluded. The remaining 858 rows total $2,705,352.522395674, reported here to cents. The post-mortem's earlier $1,779,044.83 was a protocol bad-debt snapshot, not this borrower-equity loss. Later remediation payments do not reduce incident-time loss.
USD marks use the official remediation ledger's per-liquidation corrected prices; transaction identity, ordering and LiquidateBorrow evidence were independently checked onchain.
